physicalNotes: Radius 1.72 +/- 0.041 solar radii from Bieryla et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-4641 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.52710955B/abstract): 1,196,604 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
